subject: Project Engineer, Civil (Trafalgar) application, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello Fowlers Asphalting team,

I'm applying for the Project Engineer, Civil role at your Trafalgar depot that I saw on SEEK.

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge. I tracked procurement and materials, kept material records, wrote site and progress reports and worked with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers to keep work moving. In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD, plus cost estimates and bills of quantities. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (2019).

Your advert lists material and lot traceability, quantity tracking, procurement and quality records on council and government civil jobs across Gippsland, which matches the site work I want to do. I'm based in Melton VIC and open to discussing relocation to Gippsland. I hold an Australian driver's licence and a White Card, and full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa. I haven't worked in Australian pavement construction yet, so I would start at junior level.

I've attached my resume and cover letter. Could we arrange a time to talk?

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

paragraphs: I am applying for the Project Engineer, Civil role at your Trafalgar depot advertised on SEEK. Keeping materials, work lots, quantities and quality records traceable on council and government civil jobs is the kind of site work I want to build my career on.

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As a field engineer on subdivision finishing works I tracked procurement and materials, prepared site reports, material records and progress reports, and coordinated with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers to sort out site issues. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I coordinated 10 to 15 workers a day and tracked progress against the plan.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute in Australia, covering road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards, with cost estimates, bills of quantities and risk registers. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019).

I hold an Australian driver's licence and a White Card, and I have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am based in Melton VIC and open to discussing relocation to Gippsland. I have not yet worked in Australian pavement construction, so I would start at junior level and learn your systems quickly.
I have attached my resume and would welcome the chance to talk about the role.
